formal_statement: ∀ (m l k D M W : ℕ) (g : Fin M → Fin W → MvPolynomial (Fin m × Fin l) (ZMod 2)), 0 < m → 1 ≤ l → 1 ≤ k → 1 ≤ M → k ≤ m → (m : ℝ) * Real.log (4 * (M : ℝ)) ≤ (k : ℝ) ^ 2 → 2 * (3 * l) + 1 ≤ D → (∀ (j : Fin M) (i : Fin W), (g j i).totalDegree ≤ 1) → PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.PCRefutable (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.blockSystem (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.bitPHPSystem m l) (3 * l) M W g) D → ∃ f : MvPolynomial (Fin m × Fin l) (ZMod 2), f ≠ 0 ∧ PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsRowLinear m l k f ∧ PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.PCDerivable (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.bitPHPSystem m l) (k * (D + 1)) f
plain_statement: If m ln(4M) is at most k^2, a degree-D PC refutation of the bit system extended by M blocks of accuracy 3l with affine inputs yields a nonzero row-linear polynomial of degree at most k derivable in degree k(D+1) from the bit system (Lemmas 6.4 and 6.7).
title: Chain D: removing blocks from a PC refutation leaves a nonzero row-linear consequence of bit pigeonhole
